records.text: A Scarshield Legion acolyte brings shadow magic to the Legion's fighting ranks, using Shadow Word: Pain against an opponent. The title marks a devotional role, while the Legion designation ties that role to this named force.
A Rage Talon Dragonspawn can flare into a frenzy and answer a fight with a Strike. Its name marks its dragonspawn identity, while those actions present it as a combatant.
A Scarshield Legionnaire, a soldier of the Scarshield Legion who cleaves into its enemies.
A Scarshield Spellbinder serves the Scarshield Legion in a spellcasting role.

Highlord Omokk is an ogre leader whose authority is presented as central to Blackrock's ogres: Maxwell's mission briefing says they are powerless without him. Goretooth's order names Omokk among the Blackrock Spire targets and calls him a “rotund menace.”
The Spirestone Battle Mage fights with Chain Lightning and can cast Bloodlust. Its title places it among Spirestone's battle mages, a martial spellcaster role.
The Spirestone Mystic is a spellcaster who uses Chain Lightning in combat.
The Spirestone Enforcer is a close-combat fighter who uses Strike against opponents.
The Spirestone Reaver is a heavy combatant who uses War Stomp against nearby opponents.
The Spirestone Ogre Magus is a spellcaster who fires Arcane Bolt in combat.
A Spirestone Warlord who goes into a frenzy in battle, driving himself on with Empower Will.
The Spirestone Lord Magus can enlarge an ally when that ally is badly hurt.
A Spirestone butcher, a creature found in Blackrock Spire.

Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin is a huntress in Blackrock Spire whom Kilram describes as deadly and deranged. She scarred him in what she called a "love tap," and he seeks vengeance. She fights with Curse of Blood and Hex.

War Master Voone is a troll whose battle plans are important to the Blackrock orcs’ command. Maxwell’s mission says the orcs would be thrown into chaos without them; Warlord Goretooth calls Voone cruel and ruthless. Both assign his destruction as part of their operations against Blackrock Spire.
A Smolderthorn mystic of Blackrock Spire who hurls Chain Lightning.
A Smolderthorn shadow priest of Blackrock Spire who can strip magic from its foes with Dispel Magic.
A Smolderthorn headhunter, this combatant fights with a thrown weapon. The available records establish its combat role but do not identify a more specific duty or personal history.

A warlock of the Scarshield Legion, this combatant uses shadow magic, including Shadow Bolt. The records establish its Legion affiliation and fighting method, but do not identify an individual history or further role.

A raider of the Scarshield Legion, this combatant strikes with a weapon in battle. The records establish its Legion affiliation and fighting role, but provide no individual history or more specific duty.

A grunt of the Firebrand Legion, this combatant can work itself into a frenzy and uses Mortal Strike. Its records establish a frontline fighting role, with no further individual history or duty given.

A legionnaire of the Firebrand Legion, this combatant uses improved blocking in battle. The records establish its Legion affiliation and defensive fighting role, but give no individual history or more specific duty.

A darkweaver of the Firebrand Legion, this combatant casts Shadow Bolt in battle. Its records establish its Legion affiliation and use of shadow magic, but give no individual history or more specific duty.
An invoker of the Firebrand Legion, this combatant casts Fireball in battle. Its records establish its Legion affiliation and use of fire magic, but give no individual history or more specific duty.
A Firebrand Legion dreadweaver who marks its foes with Mark of Flames.
A Firebrand Legion pyromancer who marks its foes with Mark of Flames.
A Smolderthorn shadow hunter who gouges its foes.
A Smolderthorn witch doctor who calls down a Flame Buffet Totem.
A Smolderthorn axe thrower who throws axes at its foes.
A Smolderthorn berserker who fights with Strike and Mortal Strike and, badly wounded, announces a frenzy and flies into it.
A Smolderthorn seer who keeps a Lightning Shield up when not fighting.
A Scarshield Legion worg that prowls Blackrock Spire as a guard beast.
Overlord Wyrmthalak is the taskmaster of Blackrock Spire's lesser city and a central command figure there. Warlord Goretooth's orders name him as a target.
A Bloodaxe Legion veteran in Blackrock Spire, this veteran is a seasoned combatant who fights with snap kicks and can pummel or interrupt an opponent.
Bannok Grimaxe is the Firebrand Legion's named champion in Blackrock Spire.
A Bloodaxe Legion raider in Blackrock Spire who breaks down enemy armor with sunder armor.
A Bloodaxe Legion evoker in Blackrock Spire, this spellcaster attacks with arcane bolts, bringing ranged magic to the Legion's fighting force.
A Bloodaxe Worg is a worg associated with the Scarshield Legion, found among the creatures of the Blackrock Spire area.
A Spire Scorpid is a scorpid found in the Blackrock Spire area.
A Burning Imp is a demonic creature found in the Blackrock Spire area.
A Bloodaxe Warmonger, a fighter of the Bloodaxe Legion in Blackrock Spire. It uppercuts its foes and becomes enraged.
A Bloodaxe Summoner of the Bloodaxe Legion in Blackrock Spire who hurls Arcane Missiles.
Ghok Bashguud is a Bloodaxe Champion of Blackrock Spire, a powerful fighter.
Quartermaster Zigris serves the Bloodaxe Legion in Blackrock Spire.

Pyroguard Emberseer is a fire elemental captured by orcs in upper Blackrock Spire. Hydraxis treats this servant of fire as a powerful enemy of the Waterlords, while Bodley names him among three nobles of fire. Once he regains his power and breaks free, Emberseer mocks those who freed him and threatens to burn the flesh from their bones.
A dreadweaver of the Blackhand Legion in Blackrock Spire.
A summoner of the Blackhand Legion who begins summoning Blackhand Veterans or Dreadweavers.
A veteran of the Blackhand Legion in Blackrock Spire.
Rage Talon Flamescale is a dragonkin encountered in Blackrock Spire. Its combat abilities are Fireball Volley, Fire Nova, and Flamestrike.

Lord Victor Nefarius, Lord of Blackrock, treats mortals as contemptible intruders and food for his legion. He calls his followers children, commands them to feast on attackers’ souls and threatens disobedient followers as well as enemies. He invokes the Warchief against challengers and celebrates a new age for the Blackrock legion when mortals fall. In conversation, he insists he could have taken their heads already and warns of using time as currency.
Spire Scarabs are insect creatures found in Blackrock Spire.

Halycon is a named female worg of Blackrock Spire, described as the pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg and the gigantic den mother from which Blackrock's worgs come. Her recorded death is marked by a guttural growl and an answering howl echoing through the halls.
A young worg found among the creatures of Blackrock Spire.

Bijou is a K.E.F. scout who gathers strategic intelligence inside Blackrock Spire. After a tripwire triggered an alarm, she hid her reconnaissance gear and could no longer reach it as patrols tightened. She sees the Blackrock threat as serious enough to matter to both Horde and Alliance, despite not being an Alliance sympathizer.
A demon combatant, the Burning Felhound casts Mana Burn in battle.
A demon combatant, the Burning Felguard kills itself while out of combat.

Vaelan is a dragon who guides the Seal of Ascension effort against Blackrock’s leadership. He recalls the dragonflights’ long history of losses and warns visitors to prepare for Blackrock’s lord. His directions concern three command gemstones and forging the seal with black dragonfire. At the seal’s completion, he speaks of protective wards and the red flight’s aid in the darkest hour, as Nefarian’s threat grows.
A Scarshield Legion infiltrator answers an approaching mortal with a curt dismissal: they are not worthy of its knowledge.
A Blackhand Legion incarcerator of Blackrock Spire who tries to run away in fear.
A Blackhand Elite of the Blackhand Legion; it strikes hard, yet cries "We're doomed!" in the face of danger.
A Blackhand Assassin is a Blackhand Legion stealth fighter that uses Sneak while out of combat.
A Blackhand Iron Guard is a Blackhand Legion fighter that uses Shield Slam.
General Drakkisath is a general and commander of fighters in Blackrock Spire.
A Rage Talon Dragon Guard is a dragonkin combat guard that uses Shield Slam.
A Rage Talon dragonkin captain that fights with Arcing Smash.
A Rage Talon Fire Tongue, a dragonkin fire-wielder that casts Fire Nova and Fire Blast.
Crystal Fang is a spider that summons a Spire Spiderling when it dies.
Warchief Rend Blackhand is a commander encountered mounted on a drake. When knocked from it, he cries “Impossible!” and answers “With pleasure...” to a challenge.
Chromatic Whelps are dragonkin that hurl lightning, frost and fire at their foes.
A chromatic dragonspawn that uses Cleave and Strike against opponents.
Awbee is badly injured and cries for help. Awbee asks the traveler to carry a scale to Haleh in Winterspring, so Haleh can scry what Awbee has seen and felt in this doomed place.
A Blackhand thug in Blackrock Spire.

Finkle Einhorn is a gnomish survivor who spent months trapped inside a beast before escaping. He says he snatched a piece of its flesh during his “vacation” and gives it to the adventurer to take to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook for assessment. Finkle is relieved to be free and eager to celebrate.

Warosh, known as “The Cursed,” is afflicted by Urok Doomhowl’s curse. Unable to speak clearly, he asks for help recovering his mojo. When it is returned, Warosh says his powers are coming back and his mind is free of the curse; he thanks his helper, then warns that reaching the top of Blackrock Spire would be foolish while acknowledging their bravery.
A Chromatic Elite Guard of Blackrock Spire, a dragonkin who fights with Mortal Strike.

Goraluk Anvilcrack is a Blackhand Legion armorsmith in Blackrock Spire. Lorax claims he stole a rune-covered breastplate and bartered away his soul; these are Lorax's accusations, not claims Goraluk makes himself. He strikes, cracks heads and backhands his foes.

An elder of the olden races, Elder Stonefort marks the new year and bright moon as a time when the ancients awake. He welcomes those who honor the olden races and offers a festival token. His guidance about Elder Ironband is event information.

place_records.text: You are in Blackrock Spire, the fortress capital of the Blackrock orcs, beneath Blackrock Mountain. Highlord Omokk, the ogre leader, War Master Voone, a troll whose battle plans the orcs rely on, and Overlord Wyrmthalak, taskmaster of the lesser city, command the place. Orc soldiers, dragonspawn and worg pups fill its halls, and the worgs the Blackrock orcs command are bred and trained here, and they keep coming however many are destroyed.
